name: When should I consider installing or replacing trim in my basement?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider installing or replacing trim in my basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider installing new trim during a basement finishing project to complete the aesthetic. Replacement is advisable if existing trim shows signs of water damage, such as warping, rot, or mold, indicating potential moisture issues. It's also a good idea when renovating to update the style, or if the current trim is outdated or damaged. Addressing damaged trim promptly can prevent further issues and enhance your basement's appearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Install new trim during finishing or replace it if damaged by water, outdated, or during a renovation to update the style.
